description: Typed neighbourhood of a topic, method, paper, book or author in the quant knowledge graph, with stable ids, deterministic ordering, per-edge provenance and an explicit verified or inferred flag. Depth up to 3, up to 100 nodes. Paid tool: $0.02 USDC per call via x402 v2 (solana). A call without payment returns a payment-required result.

inputSchema.description: Traverse the quant knowledge graph around one entity.

entity_id.description: Slug or id: topic/method slug ("market-microstructure", "topic:market-microstructure"), paper id ("2511.08571", "paper:2511.08571"), book id ("bw_...", "be_...") or slug, author id ("bp_...") or slug.

relationships.description: Kinds of neighbours to traverse: books (book and edition nodes), authors, papers, topics, methodologies (method nodes). All when omitted.
